about.heading: I build web apps with React and Node.js
about.intro: I study Applied Informatics and have 4 years of commercial experience alongside it. Most of my time goes into React and Node.js, where I write both the frontend and the API. Lyra runs Spotify OAuth and Google Gemini in production; other projects use Prisma with PostgreSQL and Docker. Vue.js and WordPress come from client work.
about.description: I have worked on sites for a university and for a regional government, and I build my own projects alongside that. I care about pages that load fast, read clearly, and still make sense in the code six months later.

services.title: React 19 Full-Stack Development
services.description: React 19 and TypeScript on the frontend, Node.js with Express on the backend. I write REST APIs, handle state with Zustand or TanStack Query, and deploy to Vercel and Railway with Docker.

services.title: Vue.js SPA & WordPress Development
services.description: Vue 3 with the Composition API, TypeScript, and Pinia. Plus custom WordPress themes in SCSS with GSAP animations, built for commercial clients.

services.title: API & AI Integrations
services.description: Connecting to other people's APIs: Spotify over OAuth 2.0 and Google Gemini with a fixed response schema. I also built a gateway that proxies microservices in Docker Compose and handles JWT and OAuth logins.

results.projects: finished projects, from small sites to full-stack apps

about.resultsDescription: On larger sites I handle load time with lazy loading and code splitting. I write components so they can be reused across the project.
about.currentlyDescription: I'm open to junior or medior frontend and full-stack roles where I can contribute with production-level React and Node.js experience while continuing to grow. Remote, hybrid, and on-site positions considered.

education.heading: Education & focus
education.intro: I work on real projects alongside my studies.

items.description: Master's studies focused on software system design and architecture, code quality, and engineering practices for larger-scale applications.

items.school: University of Ss. Cyril and Methodius, Trnava
items.description: Bachelor's degree covering programming, data structures, databases, networks, and web application development.

items.title: Lyra — Spotify AI Library Organizer
items.description: A full-stack app that authenticates with Spotify, ingests up to 5,000 saved tracks, and uses Google Gemini to generate playlist suggestions by genre, mood, and activity. Users review, edit, and push playlists directly back to Spotify.

items.title: Personal Blog / CMS
items.description: A TypeScript monorepo blog platform with authenticated authoring, comment threads, tag organization, image upload with media picker, and a custom Three.js WebGL animated background. 21 REST endpoints backed by PostgreSQL via Prisma.

items.title: Microservice Logger
items.description: A 5-service Docker Compose logging platform with a Sails.js API gateway proxying to FeathersJS microservices backed by MongoDB. Schema-driven data layer with JWT + OAuth auth strategies and sensitive field masking in gateway middleware.

items.title: UCM Connect — University Platform
items.description: Lead frontend developer on a Reddit-inspired community platform for the University of St. Cyril and Methodius. Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia state management, PrimeVue components, REST API integration, and Figma UI design.

items.title: Svätomariánska púť
items.description: A highly interactive WordPress website for the Prešov Region Government. Custom frontend built from Figma to pixel-perfect, responsive layouts in SCSS, with GSAP animations, Swiper.js sliders, custom JavaScript components, asset optimization via Gulp, and BrowserStack-verified cross-browser compatibility.
